{{Quote|You want to see what I have in stock? I know my kiosk isn't much to look at, but my prices are reasonable and the merchandise is sound.|translated=1|Larrim, advertising their store|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Larrim]] owned a small '''kiosk''' located in an [[South Apartments|apartment complex]] occupied by mostly [[Alien/Legends|non-humans]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where it sold basic [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] and equipment. In [[3956 BBY]], during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] spoke with Larrim at their kiosk, where the Twi'lek advertised an expensive [[Personal energy shield/Legends|energy shield]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I run a little shop here in this old building, selling basic equipment to the illegal aliens renting out these apartments.|translated=1|Larrim, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The kiosk was a small store set up in the [[South Apartments|South Apartment]]s, an apartment complex ring located in the [[Upper City]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. It consisted of a simple stand, on which products were displayed, and several adjacent [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] storage cylinders.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==History==
{{Quote|Questions? I'd rather not. It might be bad for business if people saw me answering a bunch of questions for a human. Most of the residents here are illegal aliens, questions are frowned on. I don't want to lose the trust of my customers.|translated=1|Larrim, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
[[File:Larrim.png|thumb|left|200px|The kiosk was owned by Larrim, a Twi'lek merchant.]]
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], a period of conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], a small kiosk was owned and run by<ref name="KOTOR" /> the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Gender">Game files from ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' establish [[Larrim]] as having a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] head model.</ref> [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]] [[Larrim]]. The kiosk mostly catered to [[Alien/Legends|non-humans]], who were forced to live illegally in Taris's Upper City due to the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-world's]] [[Speciesism|speciesist]] laws. Larrim sold [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], including a variety of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]], [[Mine/Legends|mines]], and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. The kiosk also offered other basic equipment, such as [[Armor/Legends|armor]], [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]], and [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]]. Larrim stocked a single expensive and hi-tech [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shield]], capable of deflecting energy attacks, such as those from blasters or [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], but not attacks from [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blasters]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' in [[3956 BBY]]</ref> a [[Attack on the Endar Spire|battle]] [[Orbit/Legends|over]] Taris between a [[Sith armada (Jedi Civil War)|Sith fleet]] and the Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' occurred. Before the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was destroyed, several [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] were launched, one of which contained [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Bastila Shan]], whose [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] [[Force power/Legends|ability]] was important to the Republic war effort. In an effort to find and capture Shan, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Malak]], ordered that Taris be [[Capture of Taris|occupied]] and quarantined, with no [[Starship/Legends|ships]] allowed to leave or land on the planet. The quarantine harmed many businesses on the world, and many off-worlders were left trapped.<ref name="KOTOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
Several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later, survivor of the battle overhead and former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], whose memories were [[Amnesia/Legends|lost]] and replaced with those of a loyal [[Republic soldier]], walked by Larrim's kiosk. Larrim approached Revan, who had been hiding out in a nearby [[Revan's hideout|abandoned apartment]], and introduced themself. The Twi'lek advertised their store and informed Revan of the [[Deflector shield/Legends|energy shield]] they were selling, explaining its rumored [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] origin and its ability to defend the user from energy attacks. Revan asked about the kiosk, and Larrim described their business and explained the situation of non-humans in the Upper City. Larrim was reluctant to answer other questions, fearing they could lose the trust of their customers. Instead, they directed Revan to [[Kadir (Tarisian)|Kadir]], the building's [[Janitor/Legends|janitor]], who had the reputation of being harmless and near-senile, and could be asked questions without drawing attention.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

Frustrated with the [[Time/Legends|time]] the search for Shan was taking, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Malak eventually ordered the [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the entire planet, [[Destruction of Taris|destroying]] the vast majority of the Upper City.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The kiosk first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. If the player walks by the kiosk, the non-player character Larrim engages them in an unavoidable conversation, in which no dialogue options affect plot, quests, or alignment. During the conversation, if Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Carth Onasi]] is in the player's party, he will comment on the uselessness of the personal energy shield against melee weapons, which caused the Republic to train their soldiers in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]]. If the player approaches the kiosk and speaks to Larrim while wearing [[Sith trooper armor/Legends|Sith trooper armor]], they cannot buy or sell items, and Larrim will instead insist they don't want trouble with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and wish Revan a good [[Local day/Legends|day]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
